description: This is an HTML document that provides a web interface for the Brainfuck programming mode in CodeMirror. It contains embedded JavaScript and CSS, references external libraries and stylesheets, and includes a sample Brainfuck program within a textarea for editing and syntax highlighting.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance on the specified textarea element with configured options such as lineNumbers, matchBrackets, and mode.
